source_message.text:
I have now completed my review, Nadia. Here is my feedback:

1\. Page1 contains only an image and no text. Is that intentional for the cover? Will the printed cover have no text, and how will it be presented?
2\. Page 2 contains only the title, subtitle, and author name, with no image. Is that the intended layout?
3\. The publication line says Published in India by Cedar Nest Family Circle. Can this be changed later?
4\. The images for the chapters listed below appear elongated. If you provide the required dimensions, I can regenerate them at the correct size so they do not look distorted.
\- Chapter6
\- Chapter11
\- Managing the In-Laws
\- For the Partner
5\. In Chapter15, the upper-right portion of the image is cut off. Once I have the proper dimensions, I can send a replacement for that image as well.
6\. I removed the full stops from the table text.
7\. Chapter18 has a different punctuation and capitalization treatment in its first line: every word begins with a capital letter. In the previous revision, that first line was formatted like a subtitle, while the following lines began on a new line as normally punctuated body text. Because both lines are now on the same level, the first line looks inconsistent.
8\. I made some minor text edits, which are available through Track changes.
9\. Could you advise what front matter and back matter content is required, and whether anything else is needed before publishing?
